class.description: Checks if robot pose is within goal window for x,y and yaw, is so, considers the goal reached once the robot crosses the goal pose's y axis
considers the goal reached if the robot pose is pointed towards a straight line along the goal pose's x-axis and ending in the goal pose

considers the goal reached if the robot pose is such that the robot can follow a target straight path starting the goal pose's x-axis with a minimum turning radius without straying from the target path more than a tolerance
